local_expression: The centered reading column uses canonical daoUI colors, spacing, radius and typography; post layout wraps for enlarged text. Both stream and thread now scroll in a viewport-wide region, including the desktop margins, following David’s approval after inspection of Threads’ public CSS. A sticky header carries original SVG quarter-circle masks and a top rule, using bg.base, bd.primary and the canonical 32px radius; decorative nodes ignore pointer input and are hidden from assistive readers. The content column grows with posts and supplies only side borders. This supersedes the earlier narrow scroll viewport. The header’s resize event supplies measured scroll margins to post controls so native Tab focus clears the header. Mobile remains edge-to-edge below the local 704px breakpoint. Write stays independently anchored at the bottom right at 48px mobile/64px desktop with a canonical 24px add icon; end clearance stays inside scroll content. The authored forty-post/twenty-reply fixture set remains separate from real identity, persistence, pagination and operator behavior. Gold composer action colors retain David’s earlier approved mapping. Browser checks do not establish native behavior. David’s visual calibration reduces the four post glyphs from 1.25rem to the canonical Whyte/sm size of 1rem while retaining the 2.75rem button targets. Shared local action styles explicitly declare pointer cursors and canonical bg.hover/bg.pressed feedback; disabled placeholders and an empty composer Post action retain default cursors. These are adapter defaults, not evidence that a canonical daoUI Exact IconButton is shipped. ThreadHero/ThreadRow/ThreadBranch adapt David’s threading reference: a full-width focused post, direct replies, one connected child preview and focused deeper conversations. The preview record retains conversation root separately from immediate parent; drafts and reply actions address that parent. This remains Jera-specific composition while the canonical Exact daoUI port is separate work. David’s subsequent header calibration removes the brand/Preview/account row on thread destinations and puts Back/Thread in its place above the rounded reading frame. Stream and thread retain independently measured sticky-header focus clearance and share the decorative cap. Focused post bodies now use the same Whyte/sm type as the feed and replies.
limits: No login, network requests, backend writes or live model replies
Post and per-post drafts reset on reload
Web evidence does not establish native typing or sheet behavior
